subject: general
question: Which of the following is INCORRECTLY matched related to the excretory system of humans?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Urethra - a pair**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **urethra** is a tube that carries urine from the **urinary bladder** to the outside of the body.
 
• In males, the urethra also carries **semen** during ejaculation.
 
• Humans have a **single urethra**, which is unpaired.
 
• The female urethra is approximately **4 cm long**, while the male urethra is about **20 cm long**.
 
• The urethra opens at the **external urethral orifice**, which is located at the tip of the penis in males and above the vaginal opening in females.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Ureter**__

 __
 
• The **ureters** are a pair of tubes that carry urine from the **kidneys** to the **urinary bladder**.
 
• Each human body has a pair of ureters, one attached to each kidney.
 
• The ureters are approximately **25-30 cm long**.
 
• They enter the urinary bladder at an oblique angle to prevent the backflow of urine.
 
 
 
• **Kidney**__
 __
 
• Humans have a pair of **kidneys**, which are vital organs for filtering blood and producing urine.
 
• Each kidney is located on either side of the spine, just below the rib cage.
 
• Kidneys help in removing waste products and excess substances from the blood.
 
• They also regulate electrolyte balance and blood pressure.
 
 
 
• **Urinary bladder**__
 
 
• The **urinary bladder** is a hollow, muscular organ that stores urine until it is excreted.
 
• It is located in the pelvis, just above and behind the pubic bone.
 
• The bladder can hold between **300-500 mL** of urine.
 
• When it is full, stretch receptors in the bladder signal the brain to initiate the urge to urinate.
